product_overview: This product is an ERP-style web application with authentication, security administration, organization master data, and lightweight notifications management. Users can log in, manage access control records, maintain organizational structures, and review or edit notification content in the frontend.
core_goals: Authenticate into the application and access the dashboard
Manage users, roles, permissions, and page registry entries for access control
Maintain organizational master data such as legal entities, branches, regions, departments, cost centers, profit centers, and location sites
Review and manage notification inbox items, templates, and channels within the app

tech_stack: Custom design-system UI kit (Button, Table, FormControls, Drawer, Toast, Pagination)

routes.description: Single-page app, no URL router. App.tsx gates the whole UI on isAuthenticated and switches screens via an in-memory navigation store (useNavigationStore.currentScreen), not real URLs.
Login screen with tabs for Login, Signup, Activate account, Forgot password, and Reset password.
Landing screen after login; navigation entry point to other modules.
Security > Users list/search/create/edit/delete, with drawers for profile and role assignment.
Security > Roles list/search/create/edit/deactivate/activate, permission-matrix drawer, copy-permissions-from-role, data-scope drawer.
Organization > Legal Entities - real backend-backed search/create/edit/deactivate/activate against /api/v1/org/legal-entities.
Organization > Branches - real backend-backed search/create/edit/deactivate/activate against /api/v1/org/branches, scoped to a parent Legal Entity.
Organization > Regions - real backend-backed search/create/edit/deactivate/activate against /api/v1/org/regions.
Organization > Departments - real backend-backed search/create/edit/deactivate/activate against /api/v1/org/departments, with a Branch FK picker.
Organization > Cost Centers - real backend-backed search/create/edit/deactivate/activate against /api/v1/org/cost-centers.
Organization > Profit Centers - real backend-backed search/create/edit/deactivate/activate against /api/v1/org/profit-centers.
Organization > Location Sites - real backend-backed search/create/edit/deactivate/activate against /api/v1/org/location-sites.
Notifications inbox - mock/local-state only, not backend-connected.
Notification templates - mock/local-state only, not backend-connected.
Notification channels - mock/local-state only, not backend-connected.

known_limitations.issue: Permissions search + module filter combo returns zero results
known_limitations.impact: Searching with both a text query and a module filter returns no results even for known permissions, while Page Registry search works correctly. Confirmed in the 2026-08-28 TestSprite run, status unconfirmed since.

known_limitations.issue: Deleting a user with existing linked data (roles, profile) returns a conflict
known_limitations.impact: Likely expected backend referential-integrity/session protection (ERR-SEC-049-DELETE), not a frontend bug.

known_limitations.issue: Notifications module is UI-only, not connected to backend API
known_limitations.impact: Inbox/templates/channels are mock/local-state only; changes are not persisted server-side.

known_limitations.issue: Organization module (Legal Entities, Branches, Regions, Departments, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Location Sites) was recently rewired from mock/local-state to real backend APIs under /api/v1/org/*
known_limitations.impact: This is newly-integrated, unverified-by-TestSprite code as of this run - expect this area to be the most likely to surface real bugs.
